verdictRationale: The spec is materially stronger, but two severe enforceability gaps remain. The final adapter pass still references `active` status before the final extraction step that is supposed to create that status, and Markdown adapters still allow non-reserved imperative prose that real harnesses may obey outside registry control.

falsifiability.failureCondition: A generated or hand-edited AGENTS.md contains an imperative instruction outside generated blocks that changes harness behavior without matching the reserved grammar.
falsifiability.observableSignal: The extractor reports zero unregistered active adapter items, but the harness follows the outside-block instruction during an agent run.
falsifiability.measurementMethod: Create a fixture AGENTS.md with a generated active block for one registered rule plus outside-block imperative text such as a required pre-command policy that avoids all reserved grammar patterns; run extraction, doctor, and a harness behavior simulation that checks whether the instruction is loaded.
falsifiability.threshold: Fail if doctor passes while the harness simulation observes any behavior sourced from outside generated active blocks.

newIssueList.title: Final adapter render depends on pre-final active status
newIssueList.description: Pass B says final adapters contain enabled entries only for capabilities whose final lifecycle status is `active`. But the lifecycle says a capability becomes `active` only after final adapter render and extraction pass. Under a literal implementation, there is no well-defined set to render: either the installer renders nothing because no capability is active yet, or it marks records active before proving the final adapter projection.
newIssueList.suggestedFix: Introduce a distinct `activation_candidate` or `doctor_passed_candidate` set computed after doctor. Pass B should render from that candidate set, then promote candidates to `active` only after final extraction equals the candidate projection.

newIssueList.title: Non-reserved Markdown prose can still carry harness behavior
newIssueList.description: The spec says arbitrary imperative prose outside generated blocks is allowed and is not treated as generated harness behavior. That is not enforceable for AGENTS.md and CLAUDE.md, because those files are instruction surfaces where prose itself can change agent behavior without using slash commands or explicit include syntax. This leaves a bypass for unregistered rules that avoid the reserved grammar.
newIssueList.suggestedFix: Require generated adapters to own all normative instruction blocks, and make unmanaged prose either fail extraction, be preserved only in a quarantined comment/non-instruction section, or be explicitly classified as unmanaged local policy that blocks strict install modes.
newIssueList.lineRef: Adapter Extraction Gate / paragraph after reserved grammar table

ledgerReview.rationale: Lifecycle states are now explicit, but final activation still has an ordering ambiguity around rendering from `active` before final extraction promotes records.
Per-type registries are canonical, capabilities.yml is generated, and digest drift has a deterministic failure mode.
Reserved syntax extraction is concrete, but arbitrary prose in instruction-bearing Markdown adapters can still introduce behavior outside typed extraction.
The local override allowlist and safety-relevant denylist are explicit and enforceable.
Fresh install, managed upgrade, migration report, and migration apply modes now have distinct failure and write policies.
Schema location, schema language, required schema files, validation command, and CI fixture expectations are defined.
The lockfile is clearly generated evidence, and doctor recomputes state before drift comparison.
Allowed lifecycle statuses and transition constraints are now enumerated and tied to inventory and adapter behavior.
The two-pass model resolves most of the circular gate, but Pass B still needs a candidate-active state separate from final `active`.
The reserved Markdown active syntax is now enumerated with case-sensitive, line-oriented extraction rules and concrete failure behavior.

preserveList.summary: Per-type registries are the only canonical authoring surface, with generated capabilities.yml guarded by source digest verification.
The lockfile trust boundary is correctly framed as generated evidence rather than proof of validity.
The two-pass adapter design is the right overall direction and only needs a cleaner candidate-to-active promotion model.
